data.one_liner: Basic animated radar chart for Flutter inspired by the Python Graph Gallery.
data.what_it_does: Provides a radar chart widget that adjusts to given data, features, and ticks. It supports features like animations on update/render, reverse axis, polygon borders, and a dark mode preset.
use_when: You need to display multi-variable data in a radar or spider chart.
You want built-in animations when the chart data updates.
avoid_when: You need complex legends or highly responsive interactive tooltips.
You are displaying a massive number of individuals which could make the graph unreadable.
strengths: Works out of the box and adjusts to given data
Supports custom polygon sides instead of circular borders
weaknesses: Customizability is a work in progress

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: A comprehensive charting library that supports line, bar, pie, scatter, and radar charts with robust features and active maintenance.
